picks.headline: OpenAI Integrates Visual Ad Formats into ChatGPT
picks.why: Marks a major shift in OpenAI's monetization strategy by introducing sponsored visual content directly into ChatGPT interactions.
picks.title: Building advertising for the way people use AI

picks.headline: SideKernel Open-Sources macOS MicroVM Sandbox for AI Coding Agents
picks.why: Solves usability friction for running untrusted agentic code execution locally in isolated microVMs on macOS.
picks.title: SideKernel: A Usable microVM Sandbox for AI Coding Agents on macOS

picks.headline: Defense Architecture Released for Securing Autonomous AI Agents on Kubernetes
picks.why: Provides a seven-layer security framework assuming LLMs are untrusted components in production Kubernetes environments.
picks.title: Containing the Autonomous Operator: A Defense-in-Depth Framework and Reference Architecture for Securing AI Agents on Kubernetes

picks.headline: Branch Steering Attacks Exploit Computer-Use Agents, Prompting COBRA Defense
picks.why: Exposes how dynamic planning in computer-use agents can be hijacked and proposes capability constraints to mitigate it.
picks.title: Securing Computer-Use Agents Against Branch Steering Attacks

picks.headline: PyTorch Ecosystem Advances Non-CUDA Hardware Enablement and Profiling
picks.why: Standardizes accelerator integration across PyTorch with unified CI relays and matured PrivateUse1 profiling backends.
picks.title: PyTorch Hardware Enablement: Updates from the Accelerator Integration Working Group

picks.headline: Hugging Face Hub Adds Native Support for RL Environments
picks.why: Standardizes the sharing and benchmark hosting of reinforcement learning environments alongside models and datasets.
picks.title: Welcome RL Environments to the hub

papers.headline: HyperThink Replaces Inference Thinking Traces with Parameter Hypernetworks
papers.why: Predicts LLM parameter updates directly per query, substituting long chain-of-thought generation with a single forward pass.
papers.title: HyperThink: Text-to-Parameter Hypernetworks for Efficient Reasoning

papers.headline: On-Policy Parameter Update Direction Improves Generalization in SFT
papers.why: Shows that RL post-training generalization comes from dynamic parameter update directions, which can be applied directly to SFT.
papers.title: On-Policy Parameter Update Direction Underlies Generalization in LLM Post-Training

papers.headline: Metropolis-Hastings Proved Superior for Test-Time LLM Policy Composition
papers.why: Demonstrates lower sampling bias across all budgets when blending policy outputs during test-time decoding.
papers.title: Metropolis-Hastings Dominates Importance Resampling for Policy Composition
